speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. To better understand your condition, how long have you been experiencing the swelling in your right knee, and does it improve with rest or worsen with activity?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia B (Christmas disease) presenting as spontaneous hemarthrosis. Given the 18-month age, right knee swelling without trauma, and family history on the maternal side, this is classic for an X-linked bleeding disorder. I recommend requesting coagulation studies to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: PT, PTT, Factor IX activity level.
